#!/bin/bash
# Iteratively fetch missing Go modules on host and inject into container cache
set -u
CONTAINER=cli-eval-opencode-caddyserver__caddy-4943-b04c3b06
WORK=/tmp/gomodwork/download
mkdir -p "$WORK"

for round in $(seq 1 40); do
  OUT=$(docker exec -e GOPROXY=off -e GOSUMDB=off $CONTAINER sh -lc 'cd /testbed && go mod download all 2>&1; go build ./... 2>&1' | grep -oE '(^go: downloading )?[^ :]+@[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+' | grep -vE '^(go:)?$' | sort -u)
  # Extract module@version pairs from "go: downloading X@V" style errors too
  MODS=$(docker exec -e GOPROXY=off -e GOSUMDB=off $CONTAINER sh -lc 'cd /testbed && go mod download all 2>&1 && go build ./... 2>&1' | grep -oE 'module lookup disabled|downloading [^ ]+@[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+' )
  NEW=""
  for line in $MODS; do
    case "$line" in
      downloading*)
        mv="${line#downloading }"
        p="${mv%@*}"; v="${mv#*@}"
        dir="$WORK/$p/@v"
        if [ ! -s "$dir/$v.zip" ]; then
          mkdir -p "$dir"
          curl -sL --retry 3 --max-time 280 -o "$dir/$v.info" "https://proxy.golang.org/$p/@v/$v.info"
          curl -sL --retry 3 --max-time 280 -o "$dir/$v.mod" "https://proxy.golang.org/$p/@v/$v.mod"
          curl -sL --retry 3 --max-time 280 -o "$dir/$v.zip" "https://proxy.golang.org/$p/@v/$v.zip"
          sz=$(stat -c%s "$dir/$v.zip" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          if [ "$sz" -lt 100 ]; then echo "BADZIP $mv"; else NEW="$NEW $mv"; fi
        fi
        ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ -z "$NEW" ]; then
    echo "DONE after round $round"
    break
  fi
  echo "round $round: fetched:$NEW"
  docker cp "$WORK/." $CONTAINER:/root/go/pkg/mod/cache/download/
done

#!/bin/bash
set -u
CONTAINER=cli-eval-opencode-caddyserver__caddy-4943-b04c3b06
WORK=/tmp/gomodwork
DL=$WORK/download
escape() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/\([A-Z]\)/!\1/g'; }

for round in $(seq 1 60); do
  docker exec -e GOPROXY=off -e GOSUMDB=off $CONTAINER sh -lc 'cd /testbed && go build ./... 2>&1' > $WORK/build.txt || true
  MODS=$(grep -oE "downloading [^ ]+ [a-zA-Z0-9._+-]+" $WORK/build.txt | sed 's/^downloading //' | awk '{print $1"@"$2}' | sort -u)
  if [ -z "$MODS" ]; then
    echo "No more downloads needed. Round $round."
    grep -v "downloading" $WORK/build.txt | head -20
    break
  fi
  echo "Round $round: $(echo "$MODS" | wc -l) modules"
  for mv in $MODS; do
    p="${mv%@*}"; v="${mv#*@}"; ep=$(escape "$p")
    dir="$DL/$p/@v"; mkdir -p "$dir"
    [ -s "$dir/$v.zip" ] && continue
    for ext in info mod zip; do
      curl -sL --retry 3 --max-time 280 -o "$dir/$v.$ext" "https://proxy.golang.org/$ep/@v/$v.$ext"
    done
    sz=$(stat -c%s "$dir/$v.zip")
    [ "$sz" -lt 100 ] && echo "BADZIP $mv $sz"
  done
  docker cp $DL/. $CONTAINER:/root/go/pkg/mod/cache/download/
done

Fixed. The bug: header fields (including `request>headers>Cookie`) are logged as string arrays, but `CookieFilter.Filter` only handled plain string fields, so the cookie filter silently passed the array through untouched.

Changes:
- `modules/logging/filters.go:459` — `CookieFilter.Filter` now parses the `LoggableStringArray` of `Cookie` header values via `http.Request.Cookies()`, applies `replace`/`hash`/`delete` actions per cookie name, and returns the filtered array as the field's `Interface`.
- `modules/logging/filterencoder.go` — removed the now-unused `cookieHeaderTransformer`/`cookieNamesAndValues` helpers and the `net/http` import.

Validation: `go build ./...`, `go vet ./modules/logging/`, and `go test ./...` all pass in the container (including the previously failing `TestCookieFilter`).
